dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses /var/tmp/ paths, COPY includes with .INC extension, LINE SEQUENTIAL files, INDEXED files with DYNAMIC access
evidence: SELECT RECECSV-FILE ASSIGN RECECSV ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access mode

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/seikyu) confirmation list generation for JMA ORCA medical practice management system
purpose.summary: This program generates a monthly insurance claim confirmation list (hoken seikyu kakunin list) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It reads from an indexed statistics file (TOKEI-FILE), processes insurance claim records by various classification keys (insurance type, submission destination, patient number, etc.), and outputs results to a CSV file and error file. It handles multiple insurance types including shakai hoken, kokuho, and kohi (public expense).

notable_features: INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access and composite key (TOKEI-KEY)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments and data names (latin-1 decoded)
Multi-level key structure for insurance claim classification
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments and string literals. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. The file is large (5565 lines, ~239KB) and shows production-quality structure with revision history dating from 2005 to 2011.
